phrases: After midnight, two police officers knock at a museum door.
They say they're answering a call.
They handcuffed the guards, and tied them up in the basement.
Eighty-one minutes later, they were gone, with thirteen works of art.
Worth up to five hundred million dollars.
Today, the empty frames still hang on the walls.
No one has ever been charged,
and the art has never been found.
Which heist should we build next?
